title: This Chinese SUV Can Spin Like a Tank. And Float #shorts

scenes.text: This Chinese SUV can spin on the spot like a tank. And in a flood, it can float.
It's the Yangwang U8, from a luxury brand owned by BYD. It has four electric motors, one at every wheel.
Left wheels forward, right wheels backward, and the whole car turns in place.
Its emergency floating mode lets it float for about thirty minutes, crawling at about three kilometers an hour, just by turning its wheels.
The catch? It costs over a hundred and fifty thousand dollars, and it's a plug-in hybrid with a gas engine on board.
So, a life-saving feature, or a party trick? Tell me in the comments. Follow EV Drive.
